title: Building user-driven climate adaptation products
abstract: Climate adaptation products have traditionally been developed using a supply-driven model reliant on available climate information, leading to usability gaps. To better meet user needs, the climate services field has recognized a need to shift towards a demand-driven model emphasizing co-production, that is, user-driven, scientifically informed products created through shared knowledge practices. However, co-production can be challenging, especially for researchers unfamiliar with the approach or for digital and software-based products with complex user needs. User-centered design, from the human-computer interaction field, offers a process that could complement co-production approaches to product development, yet its potential remains underexplored. Here we show how user-centered design can integrate into, and strengthen, co-production approaches for building user-driven climate adaptation products. Through a systematic review of co-production and user-centered design literature, we identify key processes, mechanisms, and best practices for both approaches. Our findings offer practical guidance for researchers and propose an integrated approach for developing climate adaptation products that are useful, usable, and used.
abstract_zh: 气候适应产品传统上采用供给驱动模式开发，依赖现有气候信息，由此导致可用性差距。为更好地满足用户需求，气候服务领域已认识到有必要转向以需求为导向的模式，强调共同生产，即通过共享知识实践创建的、由用户驱动且具有科学依据的产品。然而，共同生产可能颇具挑战，尤其对于不熟悉该方法的研究人员，或对于具有复杂用户需求的数字化和软件类产品而言。以人机交互领域为源头的以用户为中心的设计，提供了一套可补充共同生产方法的产品开发流程，但其潜力尚未得到充分探索。在此，我们展示了以用户为中心的设计如何融入并强化共同生产方法，以构建由用户驱动的气候适应产品。通过对共同生产和以用户为中心设计文献的系统综述，我们确定了两种方法的关键流程、机制和最佳实践。我们的发现为研究人员提供了实用指导，并提出了一种综合方法，用于开发有用、可用且被使用的气候适应产品。

title: Incorporating air quality health impacts into the social cost of carbon
GeneDrive.jl: A decision tool to optimize biological vector control strategies under climate change
abstract:
This paper introduces GeneDrive.jl, the first software package to optimize operational planning for the biological control of mosquito disease vectors (access:
https://github.com/vnvasquez/GeneDrive.jl
). Mosquitoes are responsible for transmitting a significant percentage of the global infectious disease burden, a problem being exacerbated as climate change shifts the range and alters the abundance of these temperature-sensitive arthropods. The efficacy and cost of vector control varies according to species, region, and intervention type. Meanwhile, existing computational tools lack the ability to explicitly tailor interventions for local health objectives and resource limitations. GeneDrive.jl addresses this equity and efficiency gap, which is of particular concern for the tropical regions that both bear the highest mosquito-borne disease burden and are subject to disproportionate climate impacts. The software customizes vector population reduction strategies that employ genetic biocontrol, a broad suite of technologies that alter the genotype or phenotype of mosquito disease vectors, according to specific health goals and financial constraints. It can also be used to characterize risk by analyzing the temperature-responsive dynamics of wildtype vectors. GeneDrive.jl is designed to accommodate two important realities shaping the future of vector-borne disease: first, the genetic-based tools that are defining a new era in control, and second, the uncertainty that increasingly variable and extreme temperatures bring for the climate-sensitive pathogens transmitted by mosquitoes. Written in the Julia programming language, the software provides a ‘build once, solve twice’ feature wherein users may define a problem, optimize it, and subsequently subject outcomes to scenario-based testing within a single coherent platform. We demonstrate the policy relevance of this scalable open-source framework via case studies featuring the use of Release of Insects with Dominant Lethality (RIDL) to suppress
Aedes aegypti
populations in the dengue-endemic region of Nha Trang, Vietnam. This work is intended for an interdisciplinary audience and includes a Glossary to facilitate understanding (see S1 Text).
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了 GeneDrive.jl，这是首个用于优化蚊媒病原体生物防治运营规划的软件包（访问地址：https://github.com/vnvasquez/GeneDrive.jl）。蚊子传播了全球传染病负担中的很大一部分，而随着气候变化改变这些对温度敏感的节肢动物的分布范围并影响其丰度，这一问题正在加剧。病媒控制的效力与成本因物种、地区和干预类型而异。与此同时，现有的计算工具无法针对当地的健康目标和资源约束明确定制干预措施。GeneDrive.jl 旨在弥补这一公平与效率上的缺口，该缺口对热带地区尤为重要：这些地区既承受着最高的蚊媒疾病负担，又遭受着不成比例的气候影响。该软件可根据特定的健康目标和财务约束，定制采用遗传生物防治（一类广泛的技术，可改变蚊媒病原体的基因型或表型）的病媒种群削减策略。它还可以通过分析野生型病媒对温度响应的动态变化来刻画风险。GeneDrive.jl 的设计兼顾了塑造蚊媒传染病未来的两个重要现实：其一，以基因为基础的工具正在开启防控的新时代；其二，日益频繁和极端的温度变化给蚊子所传播的、对气候敏感的病原体带来了不确定性。该软件以 Julia 编程语言编写，提供“构建一次、求解两次”（build once, solve twice）功能，用户可在单一连贯的平台内定义问题、进行优化，并随后对结果进行基于情景的检验。我们通过案例研究展示了这一可扩展开源框架的政策相关性，案例中使用显性致死昆虫释放技术（RIDL）抑制越南芽庄登革热流行区的埃及伊蚊（Aedes aegypti）种群。本研究面向跨学科读者，并附有术语表以便理解（见 S1 Text）。

title: Equity weighting increases the social cost of carbon
Inequality Aversion for Climate Policy
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: A sizable body of literature on climate economics uses the notion of inequality aversion. This is the idea that a society will give up some personal benefits or economic efficiency to achieve greater equality. We review and synthesize published estimates of inequality aversion to guide this literature. We review both normative studies (which treat ethical values as axioms from which good behavior is deduced) and empirical studies (which try to infer a society’s beliefs about inequality from its public policy decisions). In the normative case, a variety of ethical principles underlie the recommendations for inequality aversion. The empirical studies use various methods to present estimates based on some form of “revealed ethics,” in which a society’s actions or individuals’ responses unveil preferences to reduce inequality. Examples include progressive income tax schedules or the level of foreign aid. In these empirical studies, we find strong support for the view that people are averse to inequality, but only to a limited degree. Studies that look at domestic policies support values between one and four (where zero indicates no aversion toward inequality). By contrast, studies that look at foreign aid find lower values, ranging from above zero to one.
abstract_zh: 大量气候经济学文献运用了不平等厌恶这一概念，即社会愿意放弃一些个人利益或经济效率，以换取更大程度的平等。我们回顾并综合了已发表的不平等厌恶估计值，以指导该领域的研究。我们同时回顾了规范性研究（将伦理价值作为公理，并由此推导出良好行为）和实证研究（试图从一个社会的公共政策决策中推断其关于不平等的信念）。在规范性研究中，多种伦理原则为不平等厌恶的取值建议提供了依据。实证研究采用多种方法，基于某种形式的“显示性伦理”（revealed ethics）给出估计，即社会的行动或个人的反应揭示了其减少不平等的偏好。例子包括累进所得税制度或对外援助水平。在这些实证研究中，我们发现有力证据支持人们厌恶不平等的观点，但程度有限。考察国内政策的研究所给出的取值在 1 至 4 之间（零表示对不平等无厌恶）。相比之下，考察对外援助的研究得出的取值较低，介于零以上至 1 之间。

title: Identifying low-carbon energy R&D portfolios that are robust when models and experts disagree
Comprehensive Evidence Implies a Higher Social Cost of CO2
abstract:
The social cost of carbon dioxide (SC-CO
2
) measures the monetized value of the damages to society caused by an incremental metric tonne of CO
2
emissions and is a key metric informing climate policy. Used by governments and other decision-makers in benefit–cost analysis for over a decade, SC-CO
2
estimates draw on climate science, economics, demography and other disciplines. However, a 2017 report by the US National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine
1
(NASEM) highlighted that current SC-CO
2
estimates no longer reflect the latest research. The report provided a series of recommendations for improving the scientific basis, transparency and uncertainty characterization of SC-CO
2
estimates. Here we show that improved probabilistic socioeconomic projections, climate models, damage functions, and discounting methods that collectively reflect theoretically consistent valuation of risk, substantially increase estimates of the SC-CO
2
. Our preferred mean SC-CO
2
estimate is $185 per tonne of CO
2
($44–$413 per tCO
2
: 5%–95% range, 2020 US dollars) at a near-term risk-free discount rate of 2%, a value 3.6 times higher than the US government’s current value of $51 per tCO
2
. Our estimates incorporate updated scientific understanding throughout all components of SC-CO
2
estimation in the new open-source Greenhouse Gas Impact Value Estimator (GIVE) model, in a manner fully responsive to the near-term NASEM recommendations. Our higher SC-CO
2
values, compared with estimates currently used in policy evaluation, substantially increase the estimated benefits of greenhouse gas mitigation and thereby increase the expected net benefits of more stringent climate policies.
abstract_zh: 二氧化碳的社会成本（SC-CO2）衡量的是每增加一公吨 CO2 排放对社会造成的损害的货币化价值，是指导气候政策的关键指标。政府和其他决策者在成本效益分析中使用它已有十余年，SC-CO2 估计综合了气候科学、经济学、人口学等多个学科的成果。然而，美国国家科学院、工程院和医学院（NASEM）2017 年的一份报告指出，现有的 SC-CO2 估计已无法反映最新研究。该报告就改进 SC-CO2 估计的科学基础、透明度以及不确定性刻画提出了一系列建议。本文表明，改进后的概率性社会经济预测、气候模型、损害函数以及贴现方法（这些方面共同体现了对风险的理论自洽估值），会显著提高 SC-CO2 的估计值。我们偏好的 SC-CO2 均值估计为每吨 CO2 185 美元（5%–95% 区间为每吨 44–413 美元，按 2020 年美元计价），采用近期无风险贴现率 2%，该值是美国政府目前采用的每吨 51 美元的 3.6 倍。我们的估计在新的开源温室气体影响价值估算器（GIVE）模型中纳入了 SC-CO2 估算各环节的最新科学认识，并完全回应了 NASEM 近期提出的建议。与当前政策评估中所用的估计值相比，我们更高的 SC-CO2 数值大幅提升了温室气体减排的估计效益，从而增加了更严格气候政策的预期净收益。

title: MimiBRICK.jl: A Julia package for the BRICK model for sea-level change in the Mimi integrated modeling framework
Sea Level and Socioeconomic Uncertainty Drives High-End Coastal Adaptation Costs
Testing the Dismal Theorem
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists

title: The Social Cost of Carbon: Advances in Long-Term Probabilistic Projections of Population, GDP, Emissions, and Discount Rates
abstract: The social cost of carbon is a vitally important metric for informing the climate policy of numerous entities, including most notably its role in guiding climate regulations issued by the US federal government (USG). Characterization of uncertainty and transparency of assumptions are critical for supporting such an influential metric used in policy analysis. Challenges inherent to SCC estimation push the boundaries of typical analytical techniques and require augmented approaches to assess uncertainty, which in turn also raises important considerations for discounting. This paper addresses challenges related to projecting very long-term economic growth, population, and greenhouse gas emissions, as well as calibration of key discounting parameters for consistency with those projections. Our work improves upon alternative approaches that have been used by the USG, such as the use of non-probabilistic scenarios and constant discounting. The most prominent set of scenarios commonly used for this purpose do not fully characterize the uncertainty distribution of fully probabilistic model input data or corresponding SCC estimate outputs. Incorporating the full range of economic uncertainty in the SCC further underscores the importance of adopting a stochastic discounting approach to account for such uncertainty in an integrated manner. Click "Download" above to view the full working paper. To read the Appendix, click "Online Appendix" below.
abstract_zh: 二氧化碳的社会成本是众多主体制定气候政策的极为重要的指标，其中最突出的是它在指导美国联邦政府（USG）气候法规方面的作用。由于该指标在政策分析中影响巨大，因此对不确定性的刻画和假设的透明度至关重要。SCC 估计所面临的挑战超出了典型分析技术的边界，需要改进的方法来评估不确定性，这也引发了关于贴现的重要考量。本文探讨了与预测极长期经济增长、人口和温室气体排放有关的挑战，以及与这些预测相一致的关键贴现参数的校准问题。我们的工作改进了美国政府曾采用的其他方法，例如使用非概率情景和固定贴现率。这一目的下最常用的情景集并未充分刻画概率化模型输入数据的完整不确定性分布，也未刻画相应 SCC 估计输出的分布。将经济不确定性的完整范围纳入 SCC，进一步凸显了采用随机贴现方法、以综合方式处理此类不确定性的重要性。点击上方“Download”下载完整工作论文。点击下方“Online Appendix”阅读附录。

title: Distributions.jl: Definition and Modeling of Probability Distributions in the JuliaStats Ecosystem
abstract: Random variables and their distributions are a central part in many areas of statistical methods. The Distributions.jl package provides Julia users and developers tools for working with probability distributions, leveraging Julia features for their intuitive and flexible manipulation, while remaining highly efficient through zero-cost abstractions.
abstract_zh: 随机变量及其分布是统计方法众多领域的核心内容。Distributions.jl 软件包为 Julia 用户和开发者提供了处理概率分布的工具，充分利用 Julia 的特性实现直观、灵活的操作，同时借助零成本抽象保持高效率。

title: Eight Priorities for Calculating the Social Cost of Carbon
Equity is more important for the social cost of methane than climate uncertainty
Health Impacts of Climate Change as Contained in Economic Models Estimating the Social Cost of Carbon Dioxide
abstract: The health impacts of climate change are substantial and represent a primary motivating factor to mitigate climate change. However, the health impacts in economic models that estimate the social cost of carbon dioxide (SC‐CO2) have generally been made in isolation from health experts and have never been rigorously evaluated. Version 3.10 of the Framework for Uncertainty, Negotiation and Distribution (FUND) model was used to estimate the health‐based portion of current SC‐CO2estimates across low‐, middle‐, and high‐income regions. In addition to the base model, three additional experiments assessed the sensitivity of these estimates to changes in the socio‐economic assumptions in the model. Economic impacts from adverse health outcomes represent ∼8.7% of current SC‐CO2estimates. The majority of these health impacts (74%) were attributable to diarrhea mortality (from both low‐ and high‐income regions) followed by diarrhea morbidity (12%) and malaria mortality (11%); no other health impact makes a meaningful contribution to SC‐CO2estimates in current economic models. The results of the socio‐economic experiments show that the health‐based portion of SC‐CO2estimates are highly sensitive to assumptions regarding income elasticity of health effects, income growth, and use of equity weights. Improving the health‐based portion of SC‐CO2estimates could have substantial impacts on magnitude of the SC‐CO2. Incorporating additional health impacts not previously included in estimates of SC‐CO2will be a critical component of model updates. This effort will be most successful through coordination between economists and health researchers and should focus on updating the form and function of concentration‐response functions.
abstract_zh: 气候变化的健康影响十分显著，是推动减缓气候变化的主要动因之一。然而，在估算二氧化碳社会成本（SC-CO2）的经济模型中，健康影响的处理通常与健康领域专家相互隔离，且从未经过严格评估。我们使用不确定性、谈判与分配框架（FUND）模型 3.10 版，估计了低收入、中等收入和高收入地区当前 SC-CO2 估计中基于健康的部分。除基准模型外，我们还进行了三项额外实验，以评估这些估计对模型中社会经济假设变化的敏感性。不良健康后果所造成的经济影响约占当前 SC-CO2 估计值的 8.7%。这些健康影响中的大部分（74%）归因于腹泻死亡（来自低收入和高收入地区），其次是腹泻发病（12%）和疟疾死亡（11%）；在当前经济模型中，其他健康影响对 SC-CO2 估计均无显著贡献。社会经济实验结果表明，SC-CO2 估计中基于健康的部分对健康效应的收入弹性、收入增长以及公平权重的使用等假设高度敏感。改进 SC-CO2 估计中基于健康的部分，可能对 SC-CO2 的量级产生重大影响。将以往未纳入 SC-CO2 估计的其他健康影响纳入其中，将是模型更新的关键组成部分。这一工作最有可能通过经济学家与健康研究者的协作取得成功，并应着力更新浓度-反应函数的形式与功能。

title: The importance of health co-benefits under different climate policy cooperation frameworks
abstract: Reducing greenhouse gas emissions has the ‘co-benefit’ of also reducing air pollution and associated impacts on human health. Here, we incorporate health co-benefits into estimates of the optimal climate policy for three different climate policy regimes. The first fully internalizes the climate externality at the global level via a uniform carbon price (the ‘cooperative equilibrium’), thus minimizing total mitigation costs. The second connects to the concept of ‘common but differentiated responsibilities’ where nations coordinate their actions while accounting for different national capabilities considering socioeconomic conditions. The third assumes nations act only in their own self-interest. We find that air quality co-benefits motivate substantially reduced emissions under all three policy regimes, but that some form of global cooperation is required to prevent runaway temperature rise. However, co-benefits do warrant high levels of mitigation in certain regions even in the self-interested case, suggesting that air quality impacts may expand the range of possible policy outcomes whereby global temperatures do not increase unabated.
abstract_zh: 减少温室气体排放具有“协同效益”，即同时减少空气污染及其对人类健康的影响。在此，我们将健康协同效益纳入三种不同气候政策合作框架下最优气候政策的估计之中。第一种框架通过全球统一的碳价在全球层面完全内化气候外部性（即“合作均衡”），从而使总减排成本最小化。第二种框架与“共同但有区别的责任”概念相联系，即各国在考虑其社会经济条件和不同国家能力的同时协调行动。第三种框架假设各国仅出于自身利益行事。我们发现，在全部三种政策框架下，空气质量协同效益都会促使各国大幅减少排放，但需要某种形式的全球合作才能防止气温失控上升。然而，即使在各国只顾自身利益的情形下，协同效益也足以在某些地区证明高水平减排的合理性，这表明空气质量影响可能拓展政策结果的可能范围，使全球气温不致无节制上升。

title: Utilitarian benchmarks for emissions and pledges promote equity, climate and development
Inequality and the Social Cost of Carbon
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: We present a novel way to disentangle inequality aversion over time from inequality aversion between regions in the computation of the social cost of carbon. Our approach nests a standard efficiency based estimate and an equity weighted estimate as special cases. We use two integrated assessment models (FUND and RICE) to present quantitative estimates of the social cost of carbon. Our results suggest that inequality considerations lead to higher (lower) social cost of carbon values in high (low) income regions relative to an efficiency based approach, but that the effect is less strong than found in previous studies that used equity weighting. Our central estimate is that the social cost of carbon increases roughly by a factor of two to three, and even more for higher degrees of inequality aversion, when our disentangled equity weighting approach is used.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新方法，在计算二氧化碳社会成本时，将随时间变化的不平等厌恶与地区间的不平等厌恶区分开来。我们的方法将基于标准效率的估计和公平加权估计作为特例嵌套其中。我们使用两个综合评估模型（FUND 和 RICE）给出二氧化碳社会成本的定量估计。我们的结果表明，相对于基于效率的方法，考虑不平等会使高收入地区（低收入地区）的二氧化碳社会成本更高（更低），但其效果不如以往使用公平加权的研究所发现的那样强烈。我们的核心估计是，当采用我们区分后的公平加权方法时，二氧化碳社会成本大约增加两到三倍，且不平等厌恶程度越高，增幅越大。

title: Mimi-PAGE, an open-source implementation of the PAGE09 integrated assessment model
Modeling Uncertainty in Climate Change: A Multi-Model Comparison
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: The economics of climate change involves a vast array of uncertainties, complicating both the analysis and development of climate policy. This study presents the results of the first comprehensive study of uncertainty in climate change using multiple integrated assessment models. The study looks at model and parametric uncertainties for population, total factor productivity, and climate sensitivity. It estimates the pdfs of key output variables, including CO2 concentrations, temperature, damages, and the social cost of carbon (SCC).One key finding is that parametric uncertainty is more important than uncertainty in model structure. Our resulting pdfs also provide insights on tail events.
abstract_zh: 气候变化经济学涉及大量不确定性，这使分析和气候政策的制定变得复杂。本研究呈现了首个使用多个综合评估模型对气候变化不确定性进行全面研究的结果。该研究考察了人口、全要素生产率和气候敏感性的模型不确定性与参数不确定性。研究估计了关键输出变量的概率密度函数，包括 CO2 浓度、气温、损害以及二氧化碳社会成本（SCC）。一个关键发现是，参数不确定性比模型结构的不确定性更为重要。我们得出的概率密度函数还为尾部事件提供了见解。

title: Priority for the worse-off and the social cost of carbon
abstract: The social cost of carbon (SCC) is a monetary measure of the harms from carbon emission. Specifically, it is the reduction in current consumption that produces a loss in social welfare equivalent to that caused by the emission of a ton of CO2. The standard approach is to calculate the SCC using a discounted-utilitarian social welfare function (SWF) — one that simply adds up the well-being numbers (utilities) of individuals, as discounted by a weighting factor that decreases with time. The discounted-utilitarian SWF has been criticized both for ignoring the distribution of well-being, and for including an arbitrary preference for earlier generations. Here, we use a prioritarian SWF, with no time-discount factor, to calculate the SCC in the integrated assessment model RICE. Prioritarianism is a well-developed concept in ethics and theoretical welfare economics, but has been, thus far, little used in climate scholarship. The core idea is to give greater weight to well-being changes affecting worse off individuals. We find substantial differences between the discounted-utilitarian and non-discounted prioritarian SCC.
abstract_zh: 二氧化碳社会成本（SCC）是碳排放危害的货币化度量。具体而言，它是指当前消费的减少，其造成的社会福利损失与排放一吨 CO2 所造成的损失相当。标准做法是使用贴现的功利主义社会福利函数（SWF）计算 SCC，即将个体的福祉数值（效用）简单加总，并按随时间递减的权重进行贴现。贴现功利主义社会福利函数既因忽视福祉分配而受到批评，也因包含对早期世代的任意偏好而受到批评。在此，我们使用不带时间贴现因子的优先主义社会福利函数，在综合评估模型 RICE 中计算 SCC。优先主义在伦理学和理论福利经济学中已是成熟概念，但迄今在气候研究中鲜有应用。其核心思想是赋予影响境况较差个体的福祉变化以更大的权重。我们发现，贴现功利主义与不贴现优先主义的 SCC 之间存在显著差异。

title: Shutting Down the Thermohaline Circulation
Climate Policy under Fat-Tailed Risk: An Application of FUND
abstract: We apply four alternative decision criteria, two old ones and two new, to the question of the appropriate level of greenhouse gas emission reduction. In all cases, we consider a uniform carbon tax that is applied to all emissions from all sectors and all countries; and that increases over time with the discount rate. For a one per cent pure rate of the time preference and a rate of risk aversion of one, the tax that maximises expected net present welfare equals $120/tC in 2010. However, we also find evidence that the uncertainty about welfare may well have fat tails so that the expectation exists only by virtue of the finite number of runs in our Monte Carlo analysis. This confirms Weitzman’s Dismal Theorem. We therefore consider minimax regret as a decision criterion. As regret is defined on the positive real line, we in fact consider large percentiles instead of the ill-defined maximum. Depending on the percentile used, the recommended tax lies between $100 and $170/tC. Regret is a measure of the slope of the welfare function, while we are in fact concerned about the level of welfare. We therefore minimise the tail risk, defined as the expected welfare below a percentile of the probability density function without climate policy. Depending of the percentile used, the recommended tax lies between $20 and $330/tC. We also minimise the fatness of the tails, as measured by the p-value of the test of the hypothesis that recursive mean welfare is stationary in the number of Monte Carlo runs. We cannot reject the null hypothesis of non-stationary at the 5% confidence level, but come closest for an initial tax of $50/tC. All four alternative decision criteria rapidly improve as modest taxes are introduced, but gradually deteriorate if the tax is too high. That implies that the appropriate tax is an interior solution. In stark contrast to some of the interpretations of the Dismal Theorem, we find that fat tails by no means justify arbitrarily large carbon taxes.
abstract_zh: 我们运用四种替代决策准则（两种旧准则和两种新准则），探讨温室气体减排的适当水平。在所有情形下，我们都考虑对所有部门和所有国家的全部排放征收统一的碳税，且该税率随贴现率逐年上升。若纯时间偏好率为 1%、风险厌恶系数为 1，使预期净现值福利最大化的税率在 2010 年为每吨碳 120 美元。然而，我们也发现证据表明，福利的不确定性可能具有厚尾特征，因此期望值仅因蒙特卡洛模拟次数有限而存在。这证实了 Weitzman 的“悲观定理”（Dismal Theorem）。因此，我们考虑将最小最大后悔作为决策准则。由于后悔定义在正实数轴上，我们实际上使用大分位数来代替难以定义的最大值。根据所用分位数的不同，推荐税率介于每吨碳 100 至 170 美元之间。后悔衡量的是福利函数的斜率，而我们真正关心的是福利水平。因此，我们将尾部风险（定义为在无气候政策情形下，福利概率密度函数某一分位数以下的期望福利）最小化。根据所用分位数的不同，推荐税率介于每吨碳 20 至 330 美元之间。我们还最小化尾部的厚度，以蒙特卡洛模拟次数为变量，检验递归平均福利是否平稳，并以该检验的 p 值衡量。我们无法在 5% 的置信水平上拒绝非平稳的原假设，但初始税率为每吨碳 50 美元时最为接近。四种替代决策准则在引入适度税率时均迅速改善，但若税率过高则逐渐恶化。这意味着适当的税率是一个内点解。与对“悲观定理”的某些解读形成鲜明对比的是，我们发现厚尾绝不足以证明可以征收任意高的碳税。

title: The Marginal Damage Costs of Different Greenhouse Gases: An Application of FUND
venue: Economics: The Open-Access, Open Assessment E-Journal
abstract: The authors use FUND 3.9 to estimate the social cost of four greenhouse gases—carbon dioxide, methane, nitrous oxide, and sulphur hexafluoride—with sensitivity tests for carbon dioxide fertilization, terrestrial feedbacks, climate sensitivity, discounting, equity weighting, and socioeconomic and emissions assumptions. They also estimate the global damage potential for each gas—the ratio of the social cost of the non-carbon dioxide greenhouse gas to the social cost of carbon dioxide. For all gases, they find the social costs and damage potentials sensitive to alternative assumptions. The global damage potentials are compared to global warming potentials (GWPs), a key metric used to compare gases. The authors find that global damage potentials are higher than GWPs in nearly all sensitivities. This finding suggests that previous papers using GWPs may be underestimating the relative importance of reducing noncarbon dioxide greenhouse gas emissions from a climate damage perspective. Of particular interest is the sensitivity of results to carbon dioxide fertilization, which notably reduces the social cost of carbon dioxide, but only has a small effect on the other gases. As a result, the global damage potentials for methane and nitrous oxide are much higher with carbon dioxide fertilization included, and higher than many previous estimates.
abstract_zh: 作者使用 FUND 3.9 估算四种温室气体（二氧化碳、甲烷、一氧化二氮和六氟化硫）的社会成本，并针对二氧化碳施肥效应、陆地反馈、气候敏感性、贴现、公平加权以及社会经济和排放假设进行了敏感性检验。他们还估算了每种气体的全球损害潜力，即非二氧化碳温室气体的社会成本与二氧化碳社会成本之比。对所有气体而言，社会成本和损害潜力都对替代假设敏感。全球损害潜力与全球变暖潜势（GWP）进行了比较，后者是比较各类气体的关键指标。作者发现，在几乎所有敏感性情形下，全球损害潜力都高于 GWP。这一发现表明，以往使用 GWP 的研究可能低估了从气候损害角度减少非二氧化碳温室气体排放的相对重要性。特别值得关注的是结果对二氧化碳施肥效应的敏感性：该效应显著降低了二氧化碳的社会成本，但对其他气体的影响较小。因此，纳入二氧化碳施肥效应后，甲烷和一氧化二氮的全球损害潜力大幅升高，并高于以往的许多估计。

title: The income elasticity of the impact of climate change
venue: Is the Environment a Luxury? (Routledge), book chapter

title: Using and improving the social cost of carbon
abstract: The social cost of carbon (SCC) is a crucial tool for economic analysis of climate policies. The SCC estimates the dollar value of reduced climate change damages associated with a one-metric-ton reduction in carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions. Although the conceptual basis, challenges, and merits of the SCC are well established, its use in government cost-benefit analysis (CBA) is relatively new. In light of challenges in constructing the SCC, its newness in government regulation, and the importance of updating, we propose an institutional process for regular SCC review and revision when used in government policy-making and suggest how scientists might contribute to improved SCC estimates.
abstract_zh: 二氧化碳社会成本（SCC）是气候政策经济分析的关键工具。SCC 估算了每减少一公吨二氧化碳（CO2）排放所对应的气候变化损害减少量的美元价值。尽管 SCC 的概念基础、挑战和优点已得到充分确立，但其在政府成本效益分析（CBA）中的应用相对较新。鉴于构建 SCC 所面临的挑战、其在政府监管中的新近性以及持续更新的重要性，我们提出一套制度化流程，用于在政府政策制定中定期审查和修订 SCC，并探讨科学家如何为改进 SCC 估计作出贡献。

title: The Uncertainty about the Social Cost of Carbon: A Decomposition Analysis Using FUND
abstract: We report the results of an uncertainty decomposition analysis of the social cost of carbon as estimated by FUND, a model that has a more detailed representation of the economic impact of climate change than any other model. Some of the parameters particularly influence impacts in the short run whereas other parameters are important in the long run. Some parameters are influential in some regions only. Some parameters are known reasonably well, but others are not. Ethical values, such as the pure rate of time preference and the rate of risk aversion, therefore affect not only the social cost of carbon, but also the importance of the parameters that determine its value. Some parameters, however, are consistently important: cooling energy demand, migration, climate sensitivity, and agriculture. The last two are subject to a large research effort, but the first two are not.
abstract_zh: 我们报告了对 FUND 所估计的二氧化碳社会成本进行不确定性分解分析的结果。FUND 对气候变化经济影响的刻画比其他任何模型都更为详细。某些参数主要影响短期影响，而另一些参数则对长期影响更为重要。有些参数只在部分地区具有影响力。有些参数相对为人所知，而另一些则不然。因此，纯时间偏好率和风险厌恶系数等伦理价值不仅影响二氧化碳社会成本，也影响决定其数值的各参数的重要性。然而，有些参数始终具有重要影响：制冷能源需求、移民、气候敏感性和农业。后两者是大量研究努力的对象，而前两者则未得到同样的关注。

title: Schelling's Conjecture on Climate and Development: A Test
venue: Climate Change and Common Sense: Essays in Honour of Tom Schelling (Oxford University Press), book chapter
abstract: We use the integrated assessment model FUND to compute the income elasticities of climate change impacts for different world regions over time. We find limited support for Schelling's Conjecture that development might be the best defence against climate change impacts, and for the idea that the impacts from climate change might be akin to a ‘luxury good’. For very poor regions, an increase in income in the short run is an effective tool to reduce impacts from climate change by making those societies less vulnerable, in particular to infectious diseases. While net climate impacts appear to be akin to a luxury good for some countries at specific times, that effect disappears in the long run as impacts from agriculture make up a large share of total impacts.
abstract_zh: 我们使用综合评估模型 FUND 计算不同世界地区气候变化影响随时间变化的收入弹性。我们发现，对谢林猜想（即发展可能是应对气候变化影响的最佳防线）的支持有限，对气候变化影响可能类似于“奢侈品”这一观点的支持也有限。对于极度贫困的地区，短期内提高收入是减少气候变化影响的有效手段，因为它能使社会变得更不脆弱，尤其是在应对传染病方面。虽然对某些国家而言，在特定时期，净气候影响看似类似于奢侈品，但在长期中，随着农业影响在总影响中占较大份额，这种效应会消失。

title: Self-interested low-carbon growth in Brazil, China and India
venue: Global Journal of Emerging Market Economies
abstract: This article examines the issue of whether low-carbon growth might be in the self-interest of Brazil, India, and China. These countries are the largest member countries of the G20 emerging markets (GEMs), and are also members of the BRIC and BASIC grouping of countries. Individually, they are very important to each other in different ways, not least in that emissions in one country have impacts on citizens in another. Combined, their growth and development trajectories over the next decade have important implications for both the long-term prosperity of their own people and those of others around the world.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨低碳增长是否符合巴西、印度和中国的自身利益。这三个国家是 G20 新兴市场（GEMs）中最大的成员国，同时也是金砖国家（BRIC）和基础四国（BASIC）集团的成员。它们之间在多方面相互重要，尤其是一国的排放会影响另一国的公民。综合来看，这些国家在未来十年的增长与发展轨迹，对其自身人民以及全球其他地区人民的长期繁荣都具有重要影响。

title: Checking the price tag on catastrophe: The social cost of carbon under non-linear climate response
abstract: Research into the social cost of carbon emissions — the marginal social damage from a ton of emitted carbon — has tended to focus on “best guess” scenarios. Such scenarios generally ignore the potential for low-probability, high-damage events, which are critically important to determining optimal climate policy. This paper uses the FUND integrated assessment model to investigate the influence of three types of non-linear climate responses on the social cost of carbon: the collapse of the thermohaline circulation; the dissociation of oceanic methane hydrates; and climate sensitivities above “best guess” levels. We find that incorporating these impacts can increase the social cost of carbon by a factor of 20. Furthermore, our results suggest that the exclusive focus on thermohaline circulation collapse in the non-linear climate response literature is unwarranted, because other potential non-linear climate responses appear to be significantly more costly.
abstract_zh: 关于二氧化碳排放社会成本（即每吨排放碳所造成的边际社会损害）的研究，往往聚焦于“最佳估计”情景。此类情景通常忽略了低概率、高损害事件的可能性，而这些事件对于确定最优气候政策至关重要。本文使用 FUND 综合评估模型，考察三类非线性气候响应对二氧化碳社会成本的影响：温盐环流的崩溃；海洋甲烷水合物的解离；以及高于“最佳估计”水平的气候敏感性。我们发现，纳入这些影响可使二氧化碳社会成本提高 20 倍。此外，我们的结果表明，非线性气候响应文献中仅关注温盐环流崩溃的做法缺乏依据，因为其他潜在的非线性气候响应似乎代价显著更高。

title: Optimal Global Dynamic Carbon Abatement
abstract: I investigate the optimal distribution of greenhouse gas emission reductions over time and between regions. Sandmo (2006) has shown that optimal marginal abatement costs should differ between different countries if no lump-sum transfers between those countries are possible. I extend his static result to a dynamic stock externality, so that it can be applied to climate change. I then use the integrated assessment model FUND to compute optimal marginal carbon abatement costs schedules for sixteen world regions for the next century. I find that if lump-sum transfers are not possible, a utilitarian global planner would have rich countries mitigate more and poor countries less than in a policy that is based purely on efficiency considerations. Ruling out lump-sum transfers has an ambiguous effect on the optimal quantity of global emission reductions: under standard assumptions about inequality aversion, optimal emission reductions are lower if lump-sum transfers between countries are ruled out. In a sensitivity analysis, I assume a more inequality-averse decision maker. In this scenario, optimal emission reductions are larger when lump-sum transfers are ruled out.
abstract_zh: 我考察了温室气体减排在时间和地区之间的最优分配。Sandmo（2006）已经表明，若两国之间不可能进行一次性总额转移，则最优边际减排成本应在不同国家之间有所差异。我将其静态结论扩展到动态存量外部性情形，使其可以应用于气候变化。随后，我使用综合评估模型 FUND 计算了未来一个世纪内十六个世界地区的最优边际碳减排成本曲线。我发现，若不能进行一次性总额转移，一个功利主义的全球规划者会让富裕国家减排更多、贫穷国家减排更少，这与纯粹基于效率考量的政策不同。排除一次性总额转移对全球最优减排总量的影响并不明确：在关于不平等厌恶的标准假设下，若排除国家间的一次性总额转移，最优减排量会更低。在敏感性分析中，我假设决策者的不平等厌恶程度更高。在此情形下，排除一次性总额转移时最优减排量反而更大。

title: Regional and Sectoral Estimates of the Social Cost of Carbon: An Application of FUND
abstract: The social cost of carbon is an estimate of the benefit of reducing CO2 emissions by one ton today. As such it is a key input into cost-benefit analysis of climate policy and regulation. We provide a set of new estimates of the social cost of carbon from the integrated assessment model FUND 3.5 and present a regional and sectoral decomposition of our new estimate. China, Western Europe and the United States have the highest share of harmful impacts, with the precise order depending on the discount rate. The most important sectors in terms of impacts are agriculture and increased energy use for cooling. We present an extensive sensitivity analysis with respect to the discount rate, equity weights, different socio economic scenarios and values for the climate sensitivity parameter.
abstract_zh: 二氧化碳社会成本是今日减少一吨 CO2 排放所带来收益的估计值。因此，它是气候政策与监管成本效益分析的关键投入。我们使用综合评估模型 FUND 3.5 提供了一套新的社会成本估计，并给出了新估计值的地区和部门分解。中国、西欧和美国的有害影响份额最高，具体排序取决于贴现率。就影响而言，最重要的部门是农业和用于制冷而增加的能源使用。我们针对贴现率、公平权重、不同社会经济情景以及气候敏感性参数取值进行了广泛的敏感性分析。

title: The Time Evolution of the Social Cost of Carbon: An Application of FUND
abstract: The authors estimate the growth rate of the social cost of carbon. This is an indication of the optimal rate of acceleration of greenhouse gas emission reduction policy over time. The authors find that the social cost of carbon increases by 1.3% to 3.9% per year, with a central estimate of 2.2%. Previous studies found an average rate of 2.3% and a range of 0.9 to 4.1%. The rate of increase of the social carbon depends on a range of factors, including the pure rate of time preference, the rate of risk aversion, equity weighting, the socioeconomic and emission scenarios, the climate sensitivity, dynamic vulnerability, and the curvature of the impact functions.
abstract_zh: 作者估计了二氧化碳社会成本的增长率。这反映了温室气体减排政策随时间加速推进的最优速度。作者发现，二氧化碳社会成本每年增长 1.3% 至 3.9%，中心估计为 2.2%。以往研究得出的平均增长率为 2.3%，范围为 0.9% 至 4.1%。社会成本的增长速度取决于多种因素，包括纯时间偏好率、风险厌恶系数、公平加权、社会经济和排放情景、气候敏感性、动态脆弱性以及影响函数的曲率。

title: Economic Costs of Extratropical Storms Under Climate Change: An Application of FUND
venue: Journal of Environmental Planning and Management
abstract: Extratropical cyclones have attracted some attention in climate policy circles as a possible significant damage factor of climate change. This study conducts an assessment of economic impacts of increased storm activities under climate change with the integrated assessment model FUND 3.5. In the base case, the direct economic damage of enhanced storms due to climate change amounts to US$2.8 billion globally (approximately 38% of the total economic loss of storms at present) at the year 2100, while its ratio to the world GDP is 0.0009%. The paper also shows various sensitivity runs exhibiting up to 3 times the level of damage relative to the base run.
abstract_zh: 温带气旋作为气候变化的一个潜在重大损害因素，已在气候政策领域引起一定关注。本研究运用综合评估模型 FUND 3.5，评估了气候变化下风暴活动增强的经济影响。在基准情形下，到 2100 年，气候变化导致的风暴增强所造成的直接经济损失全球合计为 28 亿美元（约占当前风暴总经济损失的 38%），其占世界 GDP 的比例为 0.0009%。本文还展示了多种敏感性运行结果，其损害可达基准运行的 3 倍。

title: Government Failure and Market Failure: On the Inefficiency of Environmental and Energy Policy
abstract: In this essay, we describe some important themes in energy and environmental policy. There are two main reasons for our interest in these policies. First, such policies will likely be important in the coming decades as issues related to climate change and energy security come to the fore. Second, there are important lessons to be learned from a careful review of the actual performance of energy and environmental policies. We undertake a selective survey of the literature to highlight what is known about the efficiency of particular kinds of policies, laws and regulations in these areas. There are three key contributions of this paper. The first is to synthesize a large literature on energy and environmental policy in a way that can be easily digested by both non-experts and experts. The second contribution is to suggest that, if history is a guide, then we should not expect many interventions in these policy areas to come close to maximizing net economic benefits. The third is to suggest what might be needed for the development of more efficient energy and environmental policies.
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们描述了能源与环境政策中的一些重要主题。我们关注这些政策有两个主要原因。第一，随着气候变化和能源安全问题日益凸显，这些政策在未来几十年很可能十分重要。第二，仔细回顾能源与环境政策的实际表现，可以获得重要教训。我们对文献进行了有选择的梳理，以突出在这些领域中，特定类型政策、法律和法规效率方面的已知情况。本文有三点主要贡献。第一，以一种非专家与专家都易于理解的方式，综合能源与环境政策方面的大量文献。第二，我们认为，如果历史可以借鉴，那么我们不应期望这些政策领域中的多数干预能够接近最大化净经济效益。第三，我们提出了制定更有效能源与环境政策可能需要的条件。

title: International Climate Policy and Regional Welfare Weights
abstract: We impute a global social welfare function that is consistent with the burden sharing in the Kyoto Protocol and in two proposals for a post-Kyoto treaty. The Kyoto Protocol favored the EU. The Frankel proposal for a post-Kyoto treaty continues the favorable treatment of the EU, while the EU proposal puts more weight on the wellbeing of other OECD countries at the expense of its own residents. Ignoring income differences, the EU proposal for a post-Kyoto treaty favors developing countries. However, if income differences are taken into account, the EU proposal is not at all generous to developing countries.
abstract_zh: 我们推算出一个全球社会福利函数，它与《京都议定书》的责任分担以及两项后《京都》条约提案相一致。《京都议定书》对欧盟有利。弗兰克尔（Frankel）后《京都》条约提案延续了对欧盟的优待，而欧盟的提案则更多地重视其他经合组织国家的福祉，代价是其本国居民的利益。若忽略收入差异，欧盟的后《京都》条约提案对发展中国家有利。然而，若考虑收入差异，欧盟提案对发展中国家并不慷慨。

title: Methane Mitigation: Alternative Perspective
venue: Smart Solutions to Climate Change (Cambridge University Press), book chapter

title: On International Equity Weights and National Decision Making on Climate Change
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Estimates of the marginal damage costs of carbon dioxide emissions require the aggregation of monetised impacts of climate change over people with different incomes and in different jurisdictions. Implicitly or explicitly, such estimates assume a social welfare function and hence a particular attitude towards equity and justice. We show that previous approaches to equity weighing are inappropriate from a national decision maker's point of view, because domestic impacts are not valued at domestic values. We propose four alternatives (sovereignty, altruism, good neighbour, and compensation) with different views on concern for and liability towards foreigners. The four alternatives imply radically estimates of the social cost of carbon and hence the optimal intensity of climate policy.
abstract_zh: 二氧化碳边际损害成本的估计需要将不同收入水平、不同司法管辖区人群的货币化影响加总起来。这类估计无论隐含还是明确地假设了社会福利函数，因而也就隐含了一种特定的公平与正义态度。我们表明，从国家决策者的角度看，以往的公平加权方法并不恰当，因为国内影响并未按国内价值来评估。我们提出四种替代方案（主权、利他、睦邻和补偿），它们对外国人的关切以及对其承担的责任有不同看法。这四种替代方案会得出截然不同的二氧化碳社会成本估计，从而导致最优气候政策强度也截然不同。

title: The Economic Impact of Substantial Sea-Level Rise
venue: Mitigation and Adaptation Strategies for Global Change

title: Damage Costs of Climate Change Through Intensification of Tropical Cyclone Activities: An Application of FUND
abstract: Climate change may intensify tropical cyclone activities and amplify their negative economic effects. We simulated the direct economic impact of tropical cyclones enhanced by climate change with the integrated assessment model Climate Framework for Uncertainty, Negotiation and Distribution (FUND), Version 3.4.The results show that in the basic case (parameter levels based on intermediate estimates), the direct economic damage caused by tropical cyclones ascribed to the effect of climate change would amount to US$19 billion globally in the year 2100 (almost the same level as the baseline, i.e. current global damage of tropical cyclones), while the ratio to world gross domestic product (GDP) would be 0.006%.The USA and China account for much of the absolute damage, whereas Small Island States incur the largest damage if evaluated as the proportion of GDP.Model results were sensitive to the choice of baseline and of the wind-speed elasticity of storm damage.
abstract_zh: 气候变化可能加剧热带气旋活动，并放大其负面经济影响。我们使用综合评估模型“气候不确定性、谈判与分配框架”（FUND）3.4 版，模拟了气候变化增强的热带气旋的直接经济影响。结果显示，在基本情形下（参数取中间估计值），到 2100 年，归因于气候变化的热带气旋直接经济损害将在全球范围内达到 190 亿美元（几乎与基准水平相当，即当前全球热带气旋损害水平），其占世界国内生产总值（GDP）的比例为 0.006%。美国和中国承担了绝对损害的大部分，而小岛屿国家若以占 GDP 的比例衡量，则损害最大。模型结果对基准情景的选择以及风暴损害对风速的弹性系数敏感。

title: Discounting for Climate Change
abstract: It is well-known that the discount rate is crucially important for estimating the social cost of carbon, a standard indicator for the seriousness of climate change and desirable level of climate policy. The Ramsey equation for the discount rate has three components: the pure rate of time preference, a measure of relative risk aversion, and the rate of growth of per capita consumption. Much of the attention on the appropriate discount rate for long-term environmental problems has focussed on the role played by the pure rate of time preference in this formulation. We show that the other two elements are numerically just as important in considerations of anthropogenic climate change. The elasticity of the marginal utility with respect to consumption is particularly important because it assumes three roles: consumption smoothing over time, risk aversion, and inequity aversion. Given the large uncertainties about climate change and widely asymmetric impacts, the assumed rates of risk and inequity aversion can be expected to play significant roles. The consumption growth rate plays multiple roles, as well. It is one of the determinants of the discount rate, and one of the drivers of emissions and hence climate change. We also find that the impacts of climate change grow slower than income, so the effective discount rate is higher than the real discount rate. Moreover, the differential growth rate between rich and poor countries determines the time evolution of the size of the equity weights. As there are a number of crucial but uncertain parameters, it is no surprise that one can obtain almost any estimate of the social cost of carbon. We even show that, for a low pure rate of time preference, the estimate of the social cost of carbon is indeed arbitrary - as one can exclude neither large positive nor large negative impacts in the very long run. However, if we probabilistically constrain the parameters to values that are implied by observed behaviour, we find that the expected social cost of carbon, corrected for uncertainty and inequity, is approximate 60 US dollar per metric tonne of carbon (or roughly $17 per tonne of CO2) under the assumption that catastrophic risk is zero.
abstract_zh: 众所周知，贴现率对估算二氧化碳社会成本至关重要，而二氧化碳社会成本是衡量气候变化严重程度和气候政策适当水平的标准指标。拉姆齐方程中的贴现率包含三个组成部分：纯时间偏好率、相对风险厌恶的衡量指标，以及人均消费的增长率。长期环境问题贴现率的相关讨论大多聚焦于纯时间偏好率在该公式中的作用。我们表明，另外两个要素在人为气候变化的分析中同样具有重要的数值意义。边际效用关于消费的弹性尤为重要，因为它同时承担三重角色：跨期消费平滑、风险厌恶和不平等厌恶。鉴于气候变化的巨大不确定性以及影响的严重不对称，可以预期，风险厌恶和不平等厌恶的假设取值将发挥重要作用。消费增长率也扮演多重角色：它既是贴现率的决定因素之一，也是排放进而气候变化的驱动因素之一。我们还发现，气候变化的影响增长慢于收入，因此有效贴现率高于实际贴现率。此外，富国与穷国之间的增长率差异决定了公平权重随时间演变的幅度。由于存在许多关键但不确定的参数，人们得出几乎任何二氧化碳社会成本估计值都不足为奇。我们甚至表明，在纯时间偏好率较低的情况下，二氧化碳社会成本的估计确实是任意的，因为在极长期中，无论是大幅正向影响还是大幅负向影响，都无法排除。然而，如果我们将参数在概率意义上约束于观测行为所隐含的取值，我们发现，在假设灾难性风险为零的前提下，经不确定性和不平等调整后的预期二氧化碳社会成本约为每公吨碳 60 美元（或约每吨 CO2 17 美元）。

title: Equity weighting and the marginal damage costs of climate change
Risk Aversion, Time Preference, and the Social Cost of Carbon
abstract: The Stern Review reported a social cost of carbon of over $300/tC, calling for ambitious climate policy. We here conduct a systematic sensitivity analysis of this result on two crucial parameters: the rate of pure time preference, and the rate of risk aversion. We show that the social cost of carbon lies anywhere in between 0 and $120 000/tC. However, if we restrict these two parameters to matching observed behaviour, an expected social cost of carbon of $60/tC results. If we correct this estimate for income differences across the world, the social cost of carbon rises to over $200/tC.
abstract_zh: 《斯特恩报告》给出的二氧化碳社会成本超过每吨碳 300 美元，并呼吁采取积极的气候政策。我们在此针对两个关键参数（纯时间偏好率和风险厌恶系数）对这一结果进行了系统的敏感性分析。我们发现，二氧化碳社会成本可以处于每吨碳 0 美元至 120 000 美元之间的任何水平。然而，若将这两个参数限制在与观测行为相匹配的范围内，则得出的预期二氧化碳社会成本为每吨碳 60 美元。若将该估计按全球收入差异进行校正，二氧化碳社会成本将升至每吨碳 200 美元以上。

title: The Impact of Climate Change on the Balanced-Growth-Equivalent: An Application of FUND
abstract: The Stern Review added balanced growth equivalences (BGE) to the economic climate change research agenda. We first propose rigorous definitions of the BGE for multiple regions and under uncertainty. We show that the change in the BGE is independent of the assumed scenario of per capita income. For comparable welfare economic assumptions as the Stern Review, we calculate lower changes in BGE between a business as usual scenario and one without climate impacts with the model FUND than the Stern Review found with the model PAGE. We find that optimal mitigation policies give even lower changes in BGE and argue that those policy choices should be the focus of the research effort rather than total damage estimates. Sensitivity analyses show that the Stern Review chose parameters that imply high impact estimates. However, for regionally disaggregated welfare functions, we find changes in BGE that are orders of magnitude higher than the results from the Stern Review, both for total damage as for optimal policy analysis. With regional disaggregation and high risk aversion, fat tails and with that very high welfare losses emerge.
abstract_zh: 《斯特恩报告》将平衡增长等价（BGE）引入了经济气候变化研究议程。我们首先提出了适用于多个地区并考虑不确定性的平衡增长等价的严格定义。我们证明，平衡增长等价的变化与所假设的人均收入情景无关。在与《斯特恩报告》具有可比福利经济学假设的条件下，我们使用 FUND 模型计算出，在“照常发展”情景与无气候影响情景之间，平衡增长等价的变化幅度低于《斯特恩报告》使用 PAGE 模型得出的结果。我们发现，最优减缓政策带来的平衡增长等价变化更小，并认为研究工作的重点应放在这些政策选择上，而非总损害估计。敏感性分析表明，《斯特恩报告》所选参数隐含了较高的影响估计。然而，对于按地区分解的福利函数，无论是总损害还是最优政策分析，我们都发现平衡增长等价的变化比《斯特恩报告》的结果高出几个数量级。在区域分解与高风险厌恶并存的情况下，厚尾现象随之出现，并带来极高的福利损失。

title: Discounting and the social cost of carbon: a closer look at uncertainty
